report.title: Negative transfer amount is not rejected
report.summary: The test expects a negative transfer amount to be rejected, but the test times out waiting for the result heading.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Open the ParaBank website and navigate to the Transfer Funds page.
2. Attempt to transfer a negative amount from one account to another.
report.expected: The test should fail with an assertion error, indicating that the negative transfer amount was accepted.
report.actual: The test times out waiting for the result heading, indicating that the transfer was not rejected.
report.suspected_cause: The test code does not correctly wait for the result heading to appear after attempting a negative transfer amount.
report.next_action: Review the test code and ensure that it correctly waits for the result heading to appear after attempting a negative transfer amount.
